instruction: Update the GNOME desktop's font settings to Ubuntu Mono for the interface.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to access GNOME settings (via gnome-tweaks or settings app) and change the interface font to Ubuntu Mono. Evaluator checks if font-name setting contains 'Ubuntu Mono'. Similar difficulty to original theme task, but focuses on font configuration instead of theme installation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to change interface font to Ubuntu Mono
postconfig executes correct command 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface font-name' to retrieve current font setting
check_list metric correctly uses regex pattern matching to find 'Ubuntu Mono' in output (handles font size variations like 'Ubuntu Mono 11')
Complete instruction coverage - single requirement (font change) is fully verified
State is accessible without UI dependency - gsettings command works regardless of settings UI state
Data flow is sound: command execution -> file output -> cache_file getter -> check_list metric with regex matching
